title: Five points: Magnus nearly lost world No. 1
post:
Magnus was 5 points from losing world No. 1 😳 He saved it the day GTA 6 came out 🎮♟️ What's your rating?
Free, unlimited game reviews on Chessigma. Link in bio.
#ad #chessigma #chess #magnuscarlsen #gta6 #caruana #goat

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: GTA 6 just came out.
phrases.say: [excited] GTA six just came out.

phrases.text: Magnus has been world number one since before GTA 5.
phrases.say: Magnus has been world number one since before GTA five.

phrases.text: And this week, he almost lost it.
phrases.say: [intense] And this week, he almost lost it.

phrases.text: Five points. That's how close Caruana got.
phrases.say: Five points. That's how close Caruana got.

phrases.text: When your lowest... is their best.
phrases.say: [dramatic] When your lowest... is their best.

phrases.text: So how did the GOAT end up here?
phrases.say: So how did the goat end up here?

phrases.text: Budapest. Ten classical games. Zero wins.
phrases.say: Budapest. Ten classical games. [pause] Zero wins.

phrases.text: In one, he had under a minute on the clock... and walked into mate.
phrases.say: In one, he had under a minute on the clock... [pause] and walked into mate.

phrases.text: Even Chessigma's free game review couldn't believe it.
phrases.say: Even Chessigma's free game review couldn't believe it.

phrases.text: The internet said he's washed.
phrases.say: The internet said he's washed.

phrases.text: Then, November 19th. The day GTA 6 dropped.
phrases.say: Then, November nineteenth. [pause] The day GTA six dropped.

phrases.text: He had to beat Artemiev. A draw meant dropping below 2800 for the first time in 17 years.
phrases.say: He had to beat Artemiev. A draw meant dropping below twenty-eight hundred for the first time in seventeen years.

phrases.text: This time, Artemiev had 37 seconds. He plays queen c2.
phrases.say: This time, Artemiev had thirty-seven seconds. He plays queen c two.

phrases.text: Chessigma's review shows the move that held: knight a4.
phrases.say: Chessigma's review shows the move that held: knight a four.

phrases.text: Magnus never let go.
phrases.say: Magnus never let go.

phrases.text: Mission passed.
phrases.say: [excited] Mission passed!

phrases.text: Still number one. Still the only player above 2800.
phrases.say: Still number one. Still the only player above twenty-eight hundred.

phrases.text: At this rate, he'll still be number one when GTA 7 comes out.
phrases.say: [playful] At this rate, he'll still be number one when GTA seven comes out.

phrases.text: Magnus has a whole team to check his games. You've got Chessigma: free, unlimited game reviews.
phrases.say: Magnus has a whole team to check his games. You've got Chessigma: free, unlimited game reviews.

phrases.text: So what's your rating? Magnus is 2804.
phrases.say: So what's your rating? [pause] Magnus is twenty-eight oh four.
